messages:
melissa (PM): @angelo quick heads-up — Nimbus Dataworks pushed for a private deployment with VPC peering + customer KMS, wants it live by 2026-08-15. They're asking for 200 rps steady and p95 < 300ms. Need scope + firm delivery date for the commercial doc.
angelo (AE): Got the ask. Contract shows ARR ~ $900k ARR over 12 months if we include Dedicated + support. They'll require SLA + monthly usage reporting. I'll escalate on the commercial side.
tara (eng-l1): High-level: MVP is doable but depends on capacity commit. With 2x A100-equivalent reserved GPUs and a dedicated pool we can aim for 200 rps for short sequences. If model is larger or sequences long, we need more. Rough timelines: 6 weeks with infra slot + infra owner; 10+ weeks if we need procurement.
sachin (SE): Technical dependencies list: VPC peering, CIDR alignment, customer KMS (we need HSM passthrough support), model pinning/version lock, and audit logging for requests. Also need egress rules for monitoring telemetry.
jen (security): Compliance checklist: SOC2 logging + retention (90d), customer KMS integration support, network ACL review, and encryption-in-transit verification. We'll need a remediations plan for failed rotations.
eli (sales): If we can commit to 2026-08-15 ship date we can close the SOW this month. They want the delivery date in the SOW. If eng can't guarantee, ask for a phased delivery to protect revenue.
melissa (PM): Proposal for scope negotiation:
- Phase 1 (MVP, target 6–8 wks): VPC peering, basic KMS integration (customer-managed keys), model pinning, basic audit logs (80% of events), deployment runbook, and canary release policy.
- Phase 2 (follow-up): Full HSM rotations, extended audit retention, workload-specific quantization profiles, dedicated autoscale policies, and SLA addendum.
(This lets sales commit to a date for Phase 1 while we build Phase 2 in parallel).
angelo (AE): Phase split works for commercial. We'll put Phase 1 delivery date in SOW and gate Phase 2 deliverables as deliverable milestones.
sachin (SE): FYI here's a minimal example of the deployment config we expect customers to provide:
```yaml
private_deploy: true
vpc_peering: true
customer_kms: "projects/abcd/locations/global/keyRings/ring/cryptoKeys/key1"
model_pin: "redwood-7b-v1"
throughput_target_rps: 200
p95_latency_ms: 300
```
Note: we'll need sample CIDRs and a contact for peering.
jen (security): Also need their data retention policy. If they want logs retained >365d we'll need storage plan + CA.
deploy-bot: Deploy job #423 queued for staging at 2026-06-05 18:02 UTC — no impact to private deploy schedule.
melissa (PM): Action items:
- tara: confirm resource availability and estimated PR capacity (due EOD Fri).
- sachin: draft minimal network/KMS acceptance test (due Tue).
- jen: provide short compliance checklist to share with customer (due Tue).
- angelo/eli: update SOW with Phase 1 date placeholder and revenue split (due Wed).
Once we have resource signoff I'll ping legal for SLA language. Can everyone react with :thumbsup: if they agree to the split scope?
angelo (AE): :thumbsup:
tara (eng-l1): :thumbsup: will confirm capacity by EOD Friday.
sachin (SE): :thumbsup: will start tests.
jen (security): :thumbsup: I'll prep checklist.
eli (sales): :thumbsup: closing thread with customer on SOW alignment tomorrow.
melissa (PM): Thanks — I'll consolidate into a short note for the exec sponsor and anchor this to the Q3 OKR for Dedicated revenue.
nimbus-cs: Customer question: any chance Phase 1 can include audit exports to their S3 by default?
sachin (SE): We can add S3 export as an opt-in for Phase 1 but will need a minimal ACL and bucket policy. That won't change the timeline if they provide a bucket 48hrs before staging.
melissa (PM): Noted. I'll ask customer to provide CIDR + S3 bucket + KMS key by next Tue so we can meet the date.
melissa (PM): Closing this thread — will post status update after resource confirmation. :wave:
